not_in_roster.reason: pays tool calls made through an MCP client and server, so it cannot be pointed at an HTTP GET of one URL
an SDK and command-line proxy for MCP servers with payments; it depends on x402-fetch and takes an MCP server, not a URL

its networks are base, solana and tempo (the only EVM chain id in its source is eip155:8453), it keeps its wallet in a file under the user's home directory and defaults to a USD 5 limit; it has no Base Sepolia network, so it cannot sign any cell of the grid

its GatewayClient.pay() signs only an offer that advertises Circle Gateway batching; against /402/pay it raised No Gateway batching option available for network eip155:84532 after one unpaid request and signed nothing, and no cell advertises that option
pays a USD 0.001 pre-flight check to a third-party service before it pays any endpoint, so it sends the target URL to that service
built for the Alchemy gateway; its pay command takes a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as an argument rather than fetching a URL
supplies signatures to one vendor's SDK and is not a client of its own
too few downloads to represent what developers use; not surveyed beyond their descriptions
the package's own description calls it the Coinbase facilitator package; it configures a facilitator and is not a client

note: One line per cell. Each client is started fresh in a fresh working directory with its payment wrapper configured with a throwaway Base Sepolia payer and asked to GET /402/{scenario} once; the harness never sends a payment header for a client. Every request goes through a local recording reverse proxy that forwards it verbatim to the server and returns the answer verbatim, so each fetch lists every request the client sent for it, in order, with the x402 headers decoded into a summary (never a raw signature), and caller is what the client handed back. After 12 upstream requests in one cell the proxy answers 503 itself (budget_refused). The curl-raw lines are the control: one unpaid GET per scenario, whose payment_required summary is the offer every client in that cell was shown; the parser derives the reference from it. Nothing here is a verdict.
